_comment: A rout streaming out through a block that is fighting it (#1757). Blue (team 0): 48 Infantry on 6 files at (780, 760), facing north, put on Hold (Ctrl+H) at tick 12 so it stands its ground rather than chasing. Red (team 1): 16 Infantry at (780, 640), facing south, at morale 1, so it routs on its own at tick 46 and flees south toward its own back edge, straight into the blue block. Blue fights it from tick 176 to tick 320 while it pushes through; the router keeps all 16 men and is near (787, 1200) at tick 600. Measured with a 2-tick full state dump: blue holds its facing north throughout (-90 degrees at every sample) and its slot grid with it, so its men stay near their own places. The rout shoves blue's anchor about 52 wu south, to (775.4, 811.6). No blue man has his slot across the block's centreline from him at any tick (slots_across_centreline, DemoDefects.derived_field), the mean distance from a man to his own slot peaks at 11.5 wu (tick 254), and by tick 600 every man is back on his slot (mean 0.0 wu). On main fa76accc, with the same 2-tick dump, blue's facing and grid swung round after the router's centre as it moved through the block, ending at 72 degrees (facing south-east): 25 of 48 slots lie across the centreline at tick 300 and 16 at tick 400 (26 at most, tick 284), the mean distance to a man's own slot peaks at 85.1 wu (tick 288) and is still 15.8 wu at tick 600, and blue fails the sustained shape-residual check (47.4 wu against 13.5). The two slots_across_centreline pins below fail on main; the state pins only tie them to the story (blue fighting the router at tick 280, the router still routing at 300 and 400).
